column6: Tisza's memorandum to Franz Joseph against using the assassination as the occasion for war, for a diplomatic course first (confirming the initial level)
Tisza's dissent at the Common Ministerial Council: demands hard but not impossible to accept, mobilization only after a refusal, no annexation; the only member to oppose (confirming observation)
Tisza's memorandum to Franz Joseph repeating the alternative of an acceptable note (confirming observation)
Tisza consents to an ultimatum in conference with Berchtold, with the condition of territorial disinterest
